nivelTanque.label: Tank Level
nivelTanque.nota: The level sensor sits on top of the distribution column, not on the tank.

cargaMotor.label: Motor Load
cargaMotor.nota: The historian does not publish a series of its own for this tag.

modoVdf.label: VFD Mode
modoVdf.nota: Auto/Manual mapping not confirmed against the server.

flujoInstantaneo.label: Instantaneous Flow Rate
flujoInstantaneo.nota: Unit not declared on the server.

presionRelativa.label: Gauge Pressure
presionRelativa.nota: Unit not declared on the server.

tensionLinea.label: Line Voltage
tensionLinea.nota: The tag is named "deviation index", but it delivers a voltage.

eficienciaEnergetica.label: Energy Efficiency
eficienciaEnergetica.nota: The historian does not publish a series of its own for this tag.

nivelAltoAlto.label: High-High Level
nivelAltoAlto.nota: Level above the critical upper limit. Overflow risk.

nivelAlto.label: High Level
nivelAlto.nota: Level above the warning upper limit.

nivelBajoBajo.label: Low-Low Level
nivelBajoBajo.nota: Level below the critical lower limit. Risk of the pump running dry.

nivelBajo.label: Low Level
nivelBajo.nota: Level below the warning lower limit.

faltaDePresion.label: Loss of Pressure
faltaDePresion.nota: Pressure absent with the pump running. Indicates lost prime, obstructed suction, or a leak.

bajoFlujo.label: Low Flow
bajoFlujo.nota: Flow below the minimum with the pump running.

fallaVariador.label: VFD Fault
fallaVariador.nota: Active fault reported by the drive.

control.label: Process Control
control.nota: Turns the process on and off. Not documented in the PLC's data block.

paroDeEmergencia.label: Emergency Stop
paroDeEmergencia.nota: State of the emergency-stop circuit. Polarity unconfirmed: not shown as an alarm.

tensionL1N.label: Line Voltage (L1-N)
tensionL1N.nota: The PDF declares it in volts, but the measured value isn't plausible as a phase-to-neutral voltage on this grid. Scale unconfirmed.

tensionMaximaL1N.label: Historical Maximum Voltage (L1-N)
tensionMaximaL1N.nota: Historical maximum of tensionL1N: inherits the same scale doubt.

frecuenciaSalidaVariador.label: Drive Output Frequency
frecuenciaSalidaVariador.nota: Unscaled Modbus register (Lista-variables.pdf §1.8): the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

velocidadMotor.label: Calculated Motor Speed
velocidadMotor.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

corrienteVariador.label: Drive Output Current
corrienteVariador.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

torqueVariador.label: Torque Estimated by the Drive
torqueVariador.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

potenciaActualVariador.label: Drive Instantaneous Power
potenciaActualVariador.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

energiaAcumuladaVariador.label: Drive Accumulated Energy
energiaAcumuladaVariador.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

voltajeBusDc.label: DC Bus Voltage
voltajeBusDc.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

referenciaVariador.label: Frequency Reference Read Back from the Drive
referenciaVariador.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

potenciaNominalVariador.label: Parameterized Rated Power
potenciaNominalVariador.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

voltajeSalidaVariador.label: Output Voltage to the Motor
voltajeSalidaVariador.nota: Unscaled Modbus register: the drive's scale factor is unconfirmed.

arranqueParoLlenado.label: Filling Command
arranqueParoLlenado.nota: Start/stop command for the filling sequence.

arranqueParoVaciado.label: Draining Command
arranqueParoVaciado.nota: Start/stop command for the draining sequence.

recirculacionAutomatica.label: Automatic Recirculation
recirculacionAutomatica.nota: Enables the automatic recirculation cycle between tanks.

setpointLlenado.label: Filling Setpoint
setpointLlenado.nota: Level setpoint at which filling stops. Unit unconfirmed — assumed to be the same as Tank Level.

setpointVaciado.label: Draining Setpoint
setpointVaciado.nota: Level setpoint at which draining stops. Unit unconfirmed — assumed to be the same as Tank Level.

manualAutoS1.label: Lower Solenoid Valve Mode
manualAutoS1.nota: Mode selector for the lower solenoid valve. Auto/Manual mapping unconfirmed — same criterion as the drive mode.

arranqueParoS1.label: Lower Solenoid Valve Command
arranqueParoS1.nota: Open/close command for the lower solenoid valve.

mttoS1.label: Maintenance Lockout (S1)
mttoS1.nota: Maintenance lockout for the lower solenoid valve.

estadoS1.label: Lower Solenoid Valve State
estadoS1.nota: State of the lower solenoid valve. 0 is the PLC's initial value: treated as no data, not as off.

manualAutoS2.label: Upper Solenoid Valve Mode
manualAutoS2.nota: Mode selector for the upper solenoid valve. Auto/Manual mapping unconfirmed.

arranqueParoS2.label: Upper Solenoid Valve Command
arranqueParoS2.nota: Open/close command for the upper solenoid valve.

mttoS2.label: Maintenance Lockout (S2)
mttoS2.nota: Maintenance lockout for the upper solenoid valve.

estadoS2.label: Upper Solenoid Valve State
estadoS2.nota: State of the upper solenoid valve. 0 is the PLC's initial value: treated as no data, not as off.

manualAutoBa.label: Air Pump Mode
manualAutoBa.nota: Mode selector for the air pump. Auto/Manual mapping unconfirmed.

arranqueParoBa.label: Air Pump Command
arranqueParoBa.nota: Start/stop command for the air pump.

mttoBa.label: Maintenance Lockout (Air Pump)
mttoBa.nota: Maintenance lockout for the air pump.

estadoBa.label: Air Pump State
estadoBa.nota: State of the air pump. 0 is the PLC's initial value: treated as no data, not as off.
